briefings.title: 10 Years of Stripe France: How enterprises pivot in the age of AI

people.name: Lou Grasser
people.role: Chief Digital Operations Officer, Le Monde

briefings.tldr: As iconic French enterprises like Le Monde and Accor navigate systemic digital transitions, the rise of "agentic AI" is shifting the corporate focus from superficial interfaces to automated back-office workflows, demanding absolute executive lucidity and rapid execution to keep pace with global competitors.
